name: Behaviour adherence
purpose: Share of cases where an agent's reply acts by the principle the case tests, per principle, for each way of giving the agent the principles and for an agent without them.
record: Cases passed out of cases run for each arm on the same cases and sample, per principle, with restraint and kept-qualifier cases counted apart; one row per run in the results log, pinned to the commit, the case hash and the model.
disadvantages: The cases are written by the skill's author, so they test the behaviour the author anticipated; a reply graded by the model judge is only as good as the judge's agreement with people.
